scope: Coordinated 14 Metro overrides 0.83.3 -> 0.83.8, same minor. Expo54/RN0.81 unchanged. Upstream in-tree parser replaces image-size; no local parser patch. Remove only obsolete image-size package audit exception.
graphExplanation: image-size/queue replaced by Metro in-tree parsers; unused Babel traverse alias removed by new metro-source-map. New content-type and nested accepts/mime-types/negotiator follow new Metro requirements. 14 Metro family packages plus ob1 and 2 nested Hermes parser/ESTree pairs update. Other same-version changes are graph metadata. Incidental yaml2.9.1 resolver update rejected; full baseline yaml2.9.0 record restored within unchanged ^2.6.1 range before clean ci.

assetChecks.methodology: Actual unchanged before/after Metro asset APIs on every tracked supported image in apps/packages, matching bytes/dimensions/asset metadata. Valid synthetic PNGs with platform/scale variants and asset plugin, fallback extension and relative SVG. Candidate-only malformed buffers in a 5-second child, no network or vulnerable-baseline malformed execution. Not an exhaustive decoder security audit or Android device test.

exportComparison.interpretation: Successful paired Android Hermes exports and Web exports, plus Android candidate with --clear. Android assets unchanged after checkout-path normalization. Raw Hermes hashes differ, including repeat exports, so Android binary identity is not claimed. All paired Web export files are byte-identical; this is build compatibility, not browser interaction. No APK/native runtime or device timing proof.
